questions.stem: What is the primary constituent of natural gas, highly prized as a clean-burning fossil fuel?
questions.explanation:
WHY IT IS CORRECT: Methane (CH4) is the simplest hydrocarbon and forms the vast majority (typically 70-90%) of natural gas. It is a highly potent energy source and burns much cleaner than coal or oil, producing significantly less carbon dioxide and almost no particulate matter.
DECOY BUSTING: Propane and Butane are the primary constituents of LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas), which is the gas stored in heavy metal cylinders for household cooking. CNG (Compressed Natural Gas) used in cars is primarily methane.
EXAM INSIGHT: Methane is also a massively potent greenhouse gas (about 25 times stronger than CO2 at trapping heat). It is naturally produced by decomposing organic matter in swamps ('marsh gas') and in the stomachs of cows (enteric fermentation).

questions.stem: The incredibly strong, hard, and transparent crystal known as a Diamond is an allotrope of which single element?
questions.explanation:
WHY IT IS CORRECT: Diamond is a pure allotrope of Carbon. In a diamond, every single carbon atom is covalently bonded to four other carbon atoms in a rigid 3D tetrahedral lattice. This incredibly tight, interlocking structure makes diamond the hardest known natural substance on Earth.
DECOY BUSTING: Graphite (used in pencil lead) is another allotrope of pure Carbon. However, in graphite, the carbon atoms form flat, 2D hexagonal sheets that slide over each other easily, making it soft and slippery. Same element, entirely different physical structure.
EXAM INSIGHT: Because there are no free electrons floating around in its rigid lattice, diamond is a strict electrical INSULATOR. Graphite, however, has free electrons between its sheets, making it an excellent electrical CONDUCTOR.
